thread:
Alex (sales): POC w/ AtlasCorp failing during function-calls in JSON mode. They see intermittent HTTP 200 with empty `{}` body when calling `create_order`, and sporadic 429s. Demo scheduled tonight, need help swarming.
Priya (solutions): Which model, SDK, and are they streaming? Any sample payloads?
Alex (sales): Model: redwood/gpt-neo-32k-quant (pinned). JS SDK, streaming disabled. Function call uses JSON schema. Works for a couple calls then fails.
Tom (eng-runtime): Need raw headers + request ids. 429 could be quota; 200 with `{}` suggests parser dropped output due to truncation.
Alex (sales): Customer sent two ids: req=zz8301 (429), req=zz8302 (200 empty). Headers on 429: `x-rw-quota: 0/1000`, `x-rw-request-id: zz8301`.
Jorge (acct-mgr): They're on trial reserved quota; I can bump burst for an hour to reproduce.
Maria (security): Reminder: AC needs SQA answers; if we pull logs ensure PII redacted.
Priya (solutions): Yes, ask them to remove user payloads. We only need `x-rw-request-id` and runtime logs.
Tom (eng-runtime): Got redacted logs from support:
[2026-03-20T22:10:05Z] req=zz8301 model=redwood/gpt-neo-32k-quant status=429 reason=quota_exceeded tokens=480
[2026-03-20T22:10:06Z] req=zz8302 model=redwood/gpt-neo-32k-quant status=200 body_len=2 handler=fncall parser=struct_out error=validation_truncated
Tom (eng-runtime): `validation_truncated` means parser saw partial JSON (token cutoff) and discarded. Immediate fix: enable streaming or bump `max_output_tokens`. Long-term: improve parser to attempt partial-assembly rather than drop.
Priya (solutions): Quick customer steps: set `stream: true`, `max_output_tokens: 1024`, shorten system prompt. Also send `json_mode: strict` so they get explicit errors instead of silent `{}`.
Alex (sales): Jorge bumped burst to qps=8 for the trial. If they still see 429 after the bump I'll escalate.
deploy-bot: Note Override applied: trial-pool qps from 2->8 by Jorge at 1805011100
Maria (security): I'll share redaction script and SQA checklist with Alex. Keep any log uploads to our secure share.
Tom (eng-runtime): I'll add a per-tenant counter for `validation_truncated` and surface it in console alerts. Also logging: when we see empty body with body_len<=2, attach parser hint in logs.
Priya (solutions): I'll draft a one-pager for AC with the workaround and the SQA items.
Alex (sales): Thanks all — I'll push the changes with the customer and report back here after the demo. :rocket:
